mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate activity (HOUST) signals growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST shows sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When real final sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% and unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.5pp simultaneously over the past 3 months, it signals strong consumer demand and a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.5pp in 3 months
regime_hint: strong demand and labor market tightening
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increases by more than 1% and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 2% annualized over the past 3 months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the past month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past 6 months signals robust economic growth, which is a strong indicator of positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially during periods of economic expansion.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 shows sustained increase.
